title: Joomla Extension - joomlatools.com - Local file read through remote document links in DOCman extension < 6.2.2 -…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla DOCman extension versions prior to 6.2.2 allows users with document creation or editing permissions to read arbitrary local files on the server. This occurs because remote document links accepted the file:// scheme, enabling unauthorized local file access such as the Joomla configuration file.
